messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "get new bottle if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing"
set: ["get new bottle if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "throw away if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "swallow the mixture within 60 minutes and do not save any for later", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "discard unused liquid in trash after 60 days of opening bottle", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "taken 30 minutes before the start of single-day HEC", "at least 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast", "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose", "within 24 hours: some people get complete relief", "ask pharmacist for syringe and bottle adapter if not available", "tell doctor if symptoms do not improve within 7 days", "do not get the infusor wet"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
